purpose: Make a channel Short the one approved way: vertical lesson-video style, the teacher's art grounded, the lantern mascot with the real site flame, big text, captions, the locked teacher voice, built with the vertical renderer and checked as motion.

model.notes: a fixed weekly recipe once approved.

cost_flags: gpu time for voice and render (gpu-time grant)
owner_approval: GPU time via a gpu-time grant or the owner's own go
evaluation: Voice repeat test matches the locked hashes; the QA script passes; 4 fps sheets looked at (no wobble, flame playing, captions in sync, -14 LUFS) before hand-off.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python, headless browser renderer, ffmpeg; locked voice preset.
